tools.name: company_filings
tools.description: Search SEC EDGAR for company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.). Accepts ticker symbol or CIK number.

company.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT) or CIK number

form_type.description: Filter by form type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, 4, etc.

count.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 40)

tools.name: company_facts
tools.description: Get XBRL financial data for a company from SEC EDGAR. Returns standardized financial facts like Revenue, NetIncome, Assets, etc.

company.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL) or CIK number

concept.description: Specific XBRL concept to query (e.g., 'Revenue', 'NetIncomeLoss', 'Assets'). Use us-gaap taxonomy prefix for non-standard: 'us-gaap:AccountsPayableCurrent'. Without this, returns a summary of all available concepts.

tools.name: treasury_rates
tools.description: Get US Treasury interest rates including yield curve, bill rates, and long-term rates. No API key required.

tools.name: labor_statistics
tools.description: Get US labor market and economic statistics from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). Includes unemployment rate, CPI, payrolls, and more. No API key required (v1 API).

preset.description: Preset data series to query. Omit to see all available presets.

series_id.description: Custom BLS series ID (e.g., LAUCN040010000000005). Overrides preset.

tools.name: ticker_lookup
tools.description: Look up company ticker symbols, names, and CIK numbers. Search by ticker or company name.

query.description: Ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL) or company name to search for

tools.name: economic_overview
tools.description: Get a snapshot of key US economic indicators: Treasury yield curve, unemployment rate, CPI, and nonfarm payrolls. Multi-source overview in one call.
